title: Attention and Dread: Experimental Evidence on Preferences for Information
main_or_robustness: not applicable (lab experiment, no DiD design)

ineligible_specs.exclusion_reason: cross-sectional probit of information choice on a between-subject treatment dummy; no panel, no staggered adoption
cross-sectional probit on prior-belief treatment dummies
'difference-in-difference' is a between-subject 2x2 interaction (attention treatment x monetary lottery) in a cross-sectional probit; appendix only

eligible_reason: Laboratory experiment with between-subject treatments (AttMain vs AttControl, SL05/SLlow/SLhigh, money-lottery variants). Each subject makes one information-timing choice; analyses are binomial tests and cross-sectional probits/OLS with robust SEs. No panel, no unit or time FE, no staggered adoption.
design_notes: Published text (MS 70(10):7090-7100): Table 2 probits, N = 60 and 92 subjects. The only 'difference-in-difference' (Online Appendix B Table 3 col 2) interacts the attention treatment with a money-vs-shock lottery dummy across subjects.
data_files_note: Subject-level lab data shipped with do-file, readme.pdf and SupplMaterials.pdf.
data_provenance_note: Original lab data; irrelevant because the design is ineligible.
screener_notes: Published PDF read (data/text/mnsc/mnsc.2023.4975.txt). Clear exclusion: experiment, not a panel DiD.
